tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i yi ge rdo rje'i me phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang ba gcig pu shin tu zhi ba dam pa'i bdag /gdul dka'i mun pa stug po 'jil slad rdo rje gtum po'i nyin mor byed// gang gi yid mkhar shar ba'i mod nas grub pa bye ba'i snang ster ba// bla ma mchog dang rnam dbyer med pas shis pa'i pad+mo rgyas par mdzod// rjes su gnang bas rgyud smin nas// bsnyen dang sgrub dang las sbyor gyis// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs pa// gsang ba 'dzin dang mtshungs par 'gyur// de la dang po ni/ lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs shing*/ gzhan don kho nar rig sngags kyi dngos grub don du gnyer bas/ dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba nos te dam tshig dang sdom pa'i kun spyod la nye bar gnas pas rjes su gnang ba nod par bya'o// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i dbus su maṇ+ḍa lar me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i steng du mañji'i khar dpal gtor gtso 'khor lnga pa dar gdugs sngon pos brgyan pa/ de'i mdun du bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'bul gtor gcig chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams bkod mdzes su bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog gi snod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/

mdun rten tshom bu dang gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje gtum po mthing nag sogs nas/ rigs so sos dbu brgyan par gyur ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar gsal gdab/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la mchod bstod dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer spros bsdus sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs par bsams la bzlas pa ci nus bya/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che bai ḍūr+ya'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gang ba'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje gtum po sogs nas/ mchod bstod kyi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ gzungs thag blangs la/ bum lha'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas thon/ gzungs thag la 'khril te bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus te bum pa'i lha la thim/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ sngags ci nus bzlas mthar mchod cing bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam/ mdun bskyed la gtor ma bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol/ gsum pa ni/ dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod par/ sems bskyed gsal gdab sogs chos kyi gtam ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la 'dir dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang gzugs nus pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal lag na rdo rje zhes grags pa 'di ni/

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur pa kun tu bzang po nyid/ rdo rje theg par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyis rdo rje'i rigs su mngon par dbang bskur/ rdo rje rin po che'i myu gu'i cod pan bcings/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu stobs gcig tu gyur pa'i rdo rje phyag mtshan du gtad/ de'i tshe 'og min gyi bar gyi lha dang zhing khams thams cad du 'di ni lag na rdo rje'i zhes mgrin gcig tu bsgrags pas ming gi dbang bskur zhing gsang sngags thams cad kyi bdag por gnyer du bskos/ ma rungs pa rnams gdul bar bka' bsgos pa la brten nas khro bo'i rnam rol mtha' yas pas gdug pa can dpung dang bcas pa thams cad btul bar phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur gyi rgyud las gsungs pas mtshon mtshan dang sku'i rnam 'gyur 'dod rgur bsgyur bas zhi ba dang*/ khro bo dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/ 'khor gyi rnam par bstan pa'i bsgrub bya'i lha dang*/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sgrub byed thabs kyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sngon gyi dus na phyag rdor che ba drug gam dgur grags pa 'di rnams byin rlabs kyi bka' babs mchog dang ldan pa yin te/ de la phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po dbang gis che ba zhes drag po sum 'dul gyi rgyud la brten nas grub pa'i slob dpon dza ba ris legs par bkral zhing dbang bzhi dang bskyed rdzogs sogs zhib rgyas su yod pa bla med pha rgyud mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi khro bor gtogs pa dang*/ be con rgyud kyis che ba zhes rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud sde bco lnga tsam yod par grags pa dang gtum po khyung gis che ba zhes gsang ba mngon par bstan pa sogs kyi rgyud la brten nas grub chen las kyi rdo rjes bkral zhing khyung lnga dang nyer gcig la sogs pa'i sprul pa spro zhing*/

khyung sngags kyi sham 'dogs pas khyad par du byas pa dang*/ u tsar+ya drag sngags kyis che ba zhes 'di'i brten gzhi'i rgyud rdo rje khros par dregs pa can rnams kyi srog nas 'dren pa'i drag sngags du ma yod par grags pa dang*/ 'byung po 'dul byed nus mthus che ba'am mi dmigs kyis che ba zhes spyod rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud sogs la brten nas grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis legs par bkral zhing*/ 'phags bod du lhag pa'i lha 'di la brten nas nus mthu'i rtsal 'chang ba ji snyed cig da lta'i bar du byon pa dang*/ 'gro bzang chos skyong gis che ba zhes grub pa'i slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can 'di dang rjes su 'brel bar rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras zhi khro'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang man ngag gi bka' srol bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyag rdor mdo lugs mdze gsos kyis che ba zhes gos sngon can gyi gzungs mdo la brten nas jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyis thugs dam gyi snying por mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje bde khros klu 'dul ba'i che ba zhes mdze sogs klu'i nad gso ba la khyad par du bsngags shing dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa sogs la dar rgyas su byung ba dang*/ rdo rje me lce sde brgyad gnad la dbab pa'i che ba zhes sde brgyad kyi rigs mtha' dag gnad la dbab cing 'dul ba la lhag par stobs che ba zhig ste/ de lta bu'i lugs srol mang du byung ba las 'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i thugs sras kyi thu bo zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags zhes tshe gcig lus gcig kho nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phangs mngon du mdzad pa'i grub chen de nyid sku na phra mo'i dus su klu gdon gyis bsnyun tshul bstan pa na/

sngon las kyi 'phro sad de rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du byon/ grub pa'i slob dpon ba la tsan+d+ra las drag sngags kyi nus pa me dang 'dra ba'i dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung gis che ba'i skor yongs su rdzogs pa gsan nas gdug pa'i klu gdon las grol/ bod du phebs nas slob ma'i mchog dag la ci rigs pa stsal ba las rim par brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la'ang phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub skor dang*/ dbang dang rjes gnang man ngag gi bka' srol mang du yod pa las/ 'dir phyi sgrub lha lnga khyung sham can gyi rjes su gnang ba zab mo bgyi ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma dang rdo rje gtum po tha mi dad pa skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs/ rgyud sdom pa dang ldan par bya ba'i slad du tshogs zhing rnams kyi spyan sngar skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro bas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams lhar gsal gdab pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ swa bhā ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gtum po sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i skur gyur pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi zhing khams nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

sngags kyi mthar sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya ā be sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spos rol dang bcas yang yang brjod/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar ye shes dbab cing brtan par byas pas rjes gnang gi gzhi bkod nas/ dngos gzhi'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma rin po ches// bdag la rdo rje gtum po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang mtha' rten dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis dbang bskur byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag bdud rtsi'i rgyun yar lud de spyi bor 'khyil ba mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i cha byad can dang*/ gtum po bzhi la rigs so sos dbu brgyan par gyur/ de ltar sku'i rjes gnang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag lus kyi sgo nas phyag na rdo rje'i bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ 'bras bu'i phan yon gnas skabs su lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/

mthar thug mthu stobs dang ldan pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i sku 'grub par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang*/ slob dpon gyi lha'i sngags phreng las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon/ bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng ba ltar zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khor bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣaṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas nas spyi bor bzhag byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ de ltar gsung gi rjes gnang thob pas/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag ngag gi sgo nas phyag na rdo rje'i sngags bzla ba sogs la dbang zhing*/ gnas skabs su ngag gi nus pa che zhing 'chad rtsod sogs la mkhas pa dang*/ mthar thug bden pa'i tshig 'grub cing*/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur song snyam pa mdzod la/ sems gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du 'jog par zhu/

de ltar thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag yid kyi sgo nas phyag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la dbang zhing*/ gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes te/ mthar thug 'od gsal chos sku'i gnas lugs mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa gtor dbang gi sgo nas yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bdag gis gtor ma 'di spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gtum po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs yod par bsam/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi steng na yod pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad de dag gi zhal du gsol nas med par bsam/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sogs dang*/ spro na brgyud pa'i rim pa'ang brjod de/ rdo rje 'chang sogs nas/ rje btsun bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis la sogs te rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams spyi ltar byas la slob ma gyes/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na gshegs gsol rnams bya/ mngon rtogs kyi mjug nas 'byung ba ltar bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu/ thun mtshams kyi lha skur ldang*/ gnas gsum bsrung ba dang bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

de ltar rjes su gnang ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sngags pas/ thog mar yi dam lha dang 'brel btags pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// 'di la gnyis/ mngon rtogs spyir bstan pa dang*/ bsnyen pa'i lag len bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems yid la byed bzhin pa'i ngang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar skyabs sems rgyas pa'am/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes sogs tshig bsdus pas kyang rung ste blo rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag spro na yan lag bdun pa'ang bya/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swābhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur par bsams la/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/ tshogs gnyis kyi rang 'bras sgyu ma lta bu'i lha'i sku yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas bsgrub pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ hūm̐ las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa rno ba dbal dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkhar 'phyar bas steng phyogs gza'i gdon rnams dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar bsgrengs pas 'og phyogs klu'i gdon rnams 'joms par byed pa/

zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs shing khro gnyer g.yo ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ klu brgyad sbrul gyi rnam pas skra bcings shing sku lus brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pas gnod byed mtha' dag mnan cing ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi la shar du dri za'i gdan la sangs rgyas gtum po sku mdog dkar po thugs ka nas 'khor lo'i khyung sprul pa/ lhor gshin rje'i gdan la rin 'byung gtum po sku mdog ser po thugs ga nas rin po che'i khyung sprul pa/ nub tu klu dbang gi gdan la pad+ma gtum po sku mdog dmar po thugs ka nas pad+ma'i khyung sprul pa/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi gdan la las kyi gtum po sku mdog ljang gu thugs ka nas las kyi khyung sprul pa/ de thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa/ zhal nang du gzigs shing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i skur gyur par bsam pa ni dam tshig bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsam pa ni sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa nye bar bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par bsam pa ni sgrub pa'i yan lag go /slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/

oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag bdud rtsi'i rgyun yar lud de spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i cha byad can dang*/ gtum po bzhi la so so'i rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan par gyur par bsam pa ni sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis lha'i skur bsgrubs pa la rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos pas/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā re ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ srid gsum 'jigs byed rdo rje drag po'i sku// bdag dang gzhan gyi dpal gyur snying rje can// bdud las rnam rgyal ye shes lnga dang ldan// phyag na rdo rje che la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ ma rungs pa thams cad tshar bcad/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur pa'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas dngos grub thams cad thob par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci rigs pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtso bor bzla/ mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'ang cung zad bzlas mthar/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud srung 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas 'khor rnams la thim/ de rang lhar gsal ba la thim/ de yang hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ na da'i bar du rim gyis thim nas mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsam/ de la mi gnas pa'am spyod lam la 'jug na/ slar yang rang skad cig gis rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje gtum po 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug go /gnyis pa lag len bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ gnas khang gtsang zhing dge bar dkon mchog gi rten dang 'di nyid kyi sku rten yod na bkram pa'i mdun du 'bul gtor rin po che'i snod du yi dam gyi gtor ma stod gru gsum smad zlum po'i dbyibs 'khor bshos phran zur gsum bzhis bskor ba la 'dab chags min pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa bkod/ chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar du bsham/ nyin dang por gzhi bdag gtor ma dang spro na bgegs gtor/ gzhan yang nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya/ rang nyid stan bde ba la rten la kha phyogs pas 'khod de nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyi kun slong mi 'bral bas bsnyen sgrub mthar ma phyin bar du mi btang ba'i dam bca' brtan pos gsol 'debs ci rigs pas byin rlabs thugs dam bskul/ gzhi bdag la dkar gtor spyi ltar btang la sgrub pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar gcod mi gtong zhing dge ba'i stong grogs byed pa'i phrin las bcol/ bgegs la gtor ma bsngos te bden brjod bcas rgyang ring du bskrad la phyin chad mi 'jug pa'i srung 'khor brtan por bsgom/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs spyi 'gro bya/ sgrub thabs ltar skyabs sems lan gsum/ yan lag bdun pa dang tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag

swa bhā ba'i sngags don dran pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags la bdag bskyed gtum po lha lnga yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgom/ mchod bstod 'bul/ de nas bzlas pa la bzhi/ bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po phrin las drug dang bcas pa'o// dang po yi dam la snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul du bsnyen pa ni/ rang gtum po'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po bai ḍūr+ya zhun ma lta bu 'od 'bar ba/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis de las sngon po shas che ba'i 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pas mchod/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur nas tshur byon/ 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur thob/ dbang rtags su thod skam lnga'i rtse mor oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥs mtshan par gyur/ de rnams las rdo rje phra mo'i tshogs char ltar babs pas rang lus la rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lubs su gyur/ slar thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pas kun kyang rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur/ 'od du zhu ste rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs shing thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur nas sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ lha gzhan gyi bsnyen pa sngon du ma song na 'di nyid 'bum phrag gcig gam gsum bzla ba zhi bsnyen gong gnon gyi tshul yin la/ bsnyen pa gzhan song na 'di bzla mi dgos par bshad/ drag bsnyen dmigs pa dngos ni/ thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po/

de'i mthar mdun nas g.yas skor du badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa'i sngags phreng bai ḍūr+ya zhun ma lta bus bskor ba la sems rtse gcig tu gzung*/ gong gi spro bsdu rnams tshar re tsam byas la bzla'o// gnyis pa lha dang thugs nye bar bya ba nye bsnyen du grags pa ni/ sngags phreng las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pa g.yas su 'khor/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa'i rtse las khyung khra thabs kyi tshul du lding zhing ba spu thams cad khyung phrug phra mo grangs med pas gtams par bsams la sngags bzla'o// gsum pa lha dang dbyer med du bya ba sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ thugs ka'i rdo rje'i hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng nyid rang sgra dang bcas dang po dal bu/ rim par je mgyogs/ mthar mgal me ltar g.yas su 'khor/ 'od zer spro bsdu bsnyen pa'i skabs su smos pa'i dmigs pa phyi ma de dang*/ gtso bor sngags phreng las me 'bar/ lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas khro chung dang bya khyung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa mtshon cha me phung 'tshubs ma dang bcas pa cher 'phros pas stong gsum gyi khams gang*/ gnod byed thams cad bsad gtubs bsregs nas ming tsam med par tshar bcad par bsams la sngags bzla/ de'ang sgrub pa'i sngags dmigs 'di gtso bo yin pas dbang po rab kyis sum 'bum/ 'bring gis bdun 'bum/ tha mas 'bru 'bum sum 'gyur bzla dgos par gsungs/ dus ni rab kyis zla ba gcig 'bring gis gsum/ tha mas zla ba drug de'ang grangs dus la nges pa med/ rtags la brten dgos par gsungs pas gzhung las gsungs pa'i gtum po'i rtags brgyad ni/ lus las me 'bar ba/ rkang pa mtsho nang du rkyong ba/ ri klad la bskor ba/ rus sbal 'joms pa/ sbrul gyis rgyan byed pa/ sku gzugs bzhad pa/ me tog sngon po 'thu ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon byed pa rnams su gsungs shing*/ yang kha cig tu grub pa'i rtags brgyad ni/

rmi lam du nyi zla shar ba dang*/ de'i steng du 'dug pa dang*/ go gyon mtshon thogs pa/ me tog sngon po thu ba/ rdzong btsan por 'dug pa/ ri rab la 'dzegs pa/ lus las bskal pa'i me tshan 'bar ba ste grub pa'i rtags brgyad/ gzhan yang rgya mtshor rkang pa rkyong ba/ ri rab klad la bskor ba/ sbal lcong sdig sbrul lag gis 'joms pa/ sbrul brgyad kyis lus la brgyan pa/ yi dam gyi thang sku bzhed pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon byed pa rnams 'byung bar bshad de/ thams cad rdzogs pa'am shas cher byung ba na de nas sgrub pa las sbyor la 'jug go /zhes 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa sgrub pa chen pos phrin las la sbyor ba ni/ rang nyid rdo rje gtum po'i gnas lngar rigs lnga'i khyung chen dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu/ phyag g.yas rnams 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje rin chen ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis klu rigs lnga sbrul rang mdog can re re zhal du gsol ba/ thugs ka rdo rje'i khyung sngon po'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje gtum po rang 'dra ba'i thugs kar nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ mthar bzla bya'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas ma dag pa'i khams sbyangs/ snod kyi 'jig rten lcang lo can gyi zhing khams/ bcud kyi sems can gsang ba'i bdag po/ sgra skad thams cad yi ge bcu gcig pa'i rang sgra dir dir sgrogs par mos la nam mkhar 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin du snang stong dbyer med bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi ngang nas bzla ba dang*/ yang sngags phreng las 'phros pa'i 'od zer khyung gi tshogs su gyur nas stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gang*/ 'phur 'dzum lding zhing gshog sgra 'brug ltar bsgrags pas rang la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i klu gnyan sa bdag rnams kyi mig 'bru/ snying dang nang khrol 'dren cing zos/ spu gseb nas bye tshan gyi char phab pas sha rus phyes/ gshog pa brdabs pa'i me rlung 'tshubs mas gnod byed thams cad bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar bcom/

de dag thams cad kyi gzi brjid mthu stobs thams cad khyung rnams la thim/ khyung rnams bdag la thim pas rang nyid kyi mthu stobs gzi brjid rab tu 'bar bar bsgoms la ga ru ḍa thung 'dogs kyi sham bu can bzla/ grangs ni rang la gnod 'tshe yod na 'bum phrag gsum mam rtags thon par bzla/ med na 'bum phrag gcig tsam bzla/ 'di ni shin tu rno bas so 'dra'i bsnyen pa zhes grags so// nad gdon gding che bas des ma thul na sngags thung 'dogs sham du ring 'dogs rtsa ba'i drag sngags nyer brgyad pa ni/ hūm̐ phaṭa ṣa ṇa ro ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra ga ru ḍa de ba tha na phyung*/ sa bdag nā ga'i snying la gzer/ gnod byed thum ri li li rbad/ ces btags pa bzla ste gtum po glog phreng gi drag sngags ci la btab kyang thogs pa med par gsungs/ gal te des kyang ma thul na sngags snga ma rnams kyi bsham du drag sngags zhe dgu ma btags pa bzla ste/ nā ga tsaṇ+ḍa tshal pa ud+ga te nā ga tsit+ta shak+ti tshal pa nan/ nā ga tri sa ma ya tri/ bigh+nān/ na ga kro ta tsit+ta rā dza ya/ gnod par byed pa thams cad mā ra ya/ shi shi/ nan nan/ dul dul/ rbud rbud/ gnod byed pho mo thams cad thuṃ ri li li dzaḥ zhes so// 'di'i skabs su dmigs pa'ang gtum po'i las drug sbyor te/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad me 'od 'bar ba'i gtum pos gang*/ zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brdabs pas 'khor thams cad 'dar/ 'khor rnams kyis rang la gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs bsnun pas de rnams 'dar zhing gus pas 'dud par bsam pa ni zhabs kyi phrin las so// rang gi ba spu'i khung bu nas me phung chen po 'bar/ me lce mched cing 'tshubs/ phyogs kun tu 'khyil bas gnod byed thams cad bya sgro me la reg pa ltar bsregs par bsam pa ni sku'i phrin las so// rang gi lce zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ rtse mo re re la sngags tshan gsum re sngags mjug phyir bstan du bkod/

phaṭa gsum brul la khad pa las sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar sgrogs/ phaṭa gsum las phaṭa yig mang po ser chen babs pa bzhin 'phros pas gnod byed thams cad shwa mangs ser bas bcom pa bzhin gtor bar bsam pa ni gsung gi phrin las so// sku la klu brgyad kyi ngo bo sbrul chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa rnams kha phyir phyogs pa las mthong ba'i dug reg pa'i dug kha rlangs kyi dug mche ba'i dug bsam ngan gyi dug lnga po na bun 'khrigs pa bzhin du 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad me tog sad kyis khyer ba ltar bcom par bsam pa ni rgyan gyi phrin las so// rang gi thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang*/ khro bo'i dmag dpung chen po spros pas dgra bgegs thams cad bya spu rlung gis gtor ba ltar phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar bskrad/ 'gro bar mi byed pa thams cad myos pa dang*/ brgyal ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ 'bogs pa dang*/ yid dbyung bar byas/ la la bsad nas zos/ la la snying phyung zhing gtubs/ la la rgya mtsho chen por bskur bar bsam pa ni thugs kyi phrin las so// phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rje phyar zhing bsnun pa las rdo rje'i thog chen grangs med pa tshag sgra dang*/ 'ur sgra dang*/ khrol sgra dang bcas te 'phros pas gnod byed thams cad khang hrul la sgyogs phog pa ltar hrul hrul song*/ rdo rje gsor ba las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo'i char 'phros/ thams cad kyis phyag g.yas pas rdo rje'i tho ba bzung nas gnod byed myal myal brdungs pas phye ma rdul du brlag par bsam pa ni phyag mtshan gyi phrin las te gtum po'i las drug go /thun mthar sprul pa thams cad tshur 'dus te rang la thim/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ sku gsung thugs kyi lhag chad kha skong ba'i don du dbyangs gsal yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ rten snying lan gsum gyis brtan par bya/

de nas rdzogs rim mdor bsdus bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i lte bar thig le sngon po rgya sran tsam gyi dbus su nyi zla'i gwa'u/ de nang rang gi sems a shad dmar po spu'i rtse mo tsam mar me 'bar ba ltar gsal ba la sems gtad/ yengs med rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni zhi gnas/ de nas ci'ang yid la mi byed pa gang shar ngo bo bskyang ba ni lhag mthong ste/ 'di ni phyag rdor gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud las/ bskyed rim dmigs pa thob nas ni// snying gar ye shes sems dpa' bsgom// ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar yang*// pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi la// thig le sngon po rgya sran tsam// dbus su nyi zla'i gzhal yas khang*// gzhal yas khang gi nang du ni// a shad mar me'i rtse ltar bsgom// de la dmigs pa thob nas ni// ci yang bsam par mi bya ste// bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams na// de las ye shes thob par 'gyur// gsal la rtog med rig pa'i sku// ye shes zhes ni de la bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin cing*/ rdzogs rim rgyas pa rten med kyi rdzogs rim dang*/ rten can 'khor lo bzhi'i rdzogs rim rgyas par 'byung ba ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// slar rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po'i skur ldangs la gnas gsum bsrung*/ thun mtshams lha sngags chos nyid kyi lam khyer dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas dge ba'i bya ba spyi dang sngags bzla ba dang ma bral bar bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro nus bcud phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas dpal gsang ba'i bdag po gtum po lha lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas mnyes par bsam/ snying po'i mthar sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ sngags tsam gyis mchod/ srid gsum 'jigs byed sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces phrin las gsol/ yig brgya brjod la nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na bstim/ med na oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ 'di nyid las dngos su ma gsungs pas med ka med min kyang*/ spyi ltar spro na/ mdun du stegs bu'i steng dkyil 'khor bkram pa'am maṇ+ḍal la me tog sngon po'i tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor gang bshad ltar bkod/ bum chog skabs bum pa dri'i chu dang nyer lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang ba kha rgyan mgul chings dang ldan pa g.yas g.yon gang bder bzhag phyi mchod g.yas skor du bsham/ gzhan yang 'og tu dgos pa'i nyer mkho rnams tshogs par byas la/ gzhi bdag dang bgegs la gtor ma gtong*/ bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor bsgom/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs dang*/ rol mo byin rlabs sngags brjod/ de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldang bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/

mdun rten bsang sbyang*/ bdag bskyed nyid tshig bsgyur la bskyed chog yan lag bzhi ldan dbang skur rgyas gdab bar bya/ mchod pa ni/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad sngags rnams des 'gres sbyar/ spro na 'dod yon lnga sogs mchod pa'i rnam grangs ji ltar 'os pas kyang mchod/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad hūm̐ ste tsaṇ+ḍa ro ṣa ṇa// bden gnyis thugs chud chos kyi sku brnyes shing*// sprul pa'i skur ston phyag na rdo rje che// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang ba'i mdzod chen 'dzin pa'i dpal// gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa// sbrul stag rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// che la brjid pa'i 'jigs gzugs can// rdo rje khyung chen phyag na bsnams// ye shes me 'bar klong na bzhugs// pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan la 'gying*// gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsang ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// gza' dang sa bdag klu gnyan gyis// 'tshe bar byed las bskyab tu gsol// bsam pa'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /mthong ba'i dug dang kha rlangs dug /sbyor ba ngan pa'i dug rnams kun// zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas bstod cing phrin las gsol/ bsnyen pa nye bsnyen sgrub pa sgrub chen gyi dmigs bzlas rnams mdun bskyed la kha spos te/ bdag bskyed skabs ltar ji tsam nus pa bzla/ 'khor gtum po rigs bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ nī lam+ba ra dha ra badz+wa pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ badz+ra ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa man+ta karma rak+ṣa tsit+ta badz+ra nā ga sa ma ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang na badz+ra'i tshab la/ rat+na pad+ma karma sbyar ba'ang bshad de de rnams kyang ci 'grub bzla/ de nas bum pa bsgrub na bum bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ 'khor gtum po rigs bzhi'i sngags kyang bzla/ las sbyor bum chog skabs bzlas pa'i mgor yungs kar 'bru bdun rtsa sngags bzlas te bum par blug rtsa sngags mjug tu/ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ sarba pā paṃ bi nā sa a a zhes btags pa ci 'grub dang*/ bum lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang*/ chu'i rdul zhun re re'ang khro chung dang khyung gi rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa kā ya wā ka tsit+ta swa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa'ang mang du bzlas pa'i mthar 'od zhu bya/ mdun bskyed la gtor ma gong ltar 'bul/ 'di skabs lha spyan 'dren mi dgos mdun bskyed la dmigs pa yin no// skabs 'dir rjes gnang*/ bum khrus sogs dgos na bya/ de nas mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ sngar ltar mchod bstod phrin bcol bya/ nongs pa bzod gsol/ sgrub zhag snga ma rnams su dkyil 'khor mi bsdu ba de gar bzhag sgrub pa rdzogs dus/ mdun bskyed ye shes pa rten yod na de la bstim zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs su gsol/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis brjod pas 'grub bo// de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhag bdun la sogs pa ji ltar nus pa bsgrub par bya ste 'di la rtags brgyad sgug pa sogs mi dgos so// gsum pa las sbyor nyer mkho kha shas tsam ni/ srung ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo phyogs bcu khyab par 'phros pas gnod byed gdug pa can rnams dpa' bkong zhing tshar bcad/

tshur 'dus pa las 'khor lo'i gur khang*/ de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i gur khang me ri rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ bsrung bya thams cad 'khor lo'i nang du tshud/ gal chen yod na de nyid thugs srog hūm̐ gi nang du bsgom/ rtsa sngags sham bur/ ma ma kā ya wā k+tsit+ta rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ mām̐ swā hā/ btags pa ci nus bzla/ bsrung bya dmigs bsal yod na/ ma ma'i tshab tu de nyid kyi ming sbyar/ de ni rang gzhan thams cad srung ba'i mchog go /khyim du gdon chen zhugs pa phud na/ thog mar sgom bzlas bya/ de nas phyi nang snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid 'od du zhu thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu yar thim nas ham̐ du gyur/ de las me cher 'bar bas sdod pa'i gnas khang bsregs/ me cher mched pas yul khams thams cad kyang bsregs/ me las sngags sgra drag po 'brug ltar du sgrogs par bsams la/ rtsa sngags sham du gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ ces btags pa drag tu bzla'o// rang la gza'i gnod pa byung na/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag por gsal ba'i mdun du gza' chen brgyad sku stod drang srong gi gzugs thal mo sbyar zhing bdag la gus pa'i tshul can/ sku smad sbrul mjug brgyad po rang gi gdan 'og tu mnan pa/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ gza' nad thams cad ba mor nyi ma phog pa bzhin bcom/ rang gi thugs ka nas gsang bdag tshon gang pa brgyad spros/ gza' brgyad kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying gar thim pas dam la btags shing byin gyis brlabs/ phyin chad gnod pa mi byed par khas blangs shing dam bcas par bsams la/ rtsa sngags sham du/ rak+ṣa rā hu la gza' kha ṭa ru ṭa sa ma ya tsit+ta hriṃ dzaḥhriṃ dzaḥphaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes btags pa stong phrag la sogs pa gdon tshabs che chung dang bstun nas bzla/ rkang lag sogs nad dmigs rnams su sngags mchil gdab/ gzhan gza' nad kyis zin pa la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po rang 'dra ba gza' brgyad zhabs kyis mnan pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/

nad pa'i nad dmigs rnams su thim par bsgoms la rtsa sngags sham du/ gza' kha ṭa ru ṭa rak+ṣa rā hu la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya rak+ṣ+yaṃ du a dhiṣ+ṭhān hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes btags pa brgya rtsa la sogs bzlas pa'i mchil ma dang phu btab pas phan par gsung*/ bum mchog gong du smos pa ltar bsgrubs pa'i chu des rang la tho rangs khrus chab byas pas grib kyi rigs kyis mi tshugs shing*/ bum chu btung ba dang bkrus pas 'go ba'i nad srung*/ mi phyugs glo bur du na ba rnams la'ang blud pa dang bskrus pas 'phral du bde bar 'gyur/ sri'u yin na rtag tu btung ba dang bkru/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur la gtor ma sngas srung du bzhag pas sri keg las thar/ smyon pa sogs nad pa gdon can la dang po cha gsum btang la bden stobs brjod pas bskrad/ de nas byabs khrus spyi ltar du bya/ bum pa dang gtor ma sogs kyi dbang bskur bas smyo 'bogs dang*/ klu dang sa bdag gi nad/ dug rigs dang mdze rigs bco brgyad sel/ mjug tu gtor zan kham du bzar bcug pas nad las grol bar gsungs/ rang gtum por gsal ba'i ba spu'i bu ga nas khro chung mtshon cha thogs pa skar mda' ltar 'khrugs/ rang nyid bskal pa'i me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku las me phung dang khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gnod byed gang yin pa nam mkha'i pha mthar bskrad par bsgoms la rtsa sngags kyi sham du/ oṃ rak+ta s+t+waṃ bha ya chings chings swā hā/ zhes btags pa bzlas pas pho gdon rgyal po'i gnod pa zlog bh+yo ma ma tra ka rak+ṣa ma ma trag tu swā hā/ zhes btags pa bzlas pas mo gdon bsen mo'i rigs kyi gnod pa zlog par gsungs/ gzhan yang gsang ba thugs kyi phur gcig la brtan nas drag po'i las tshogs dang*/ sbyin sreg gi las sbyor/ gtad khrol dang*/ klu dang sa bdag gi nad bkrol ba/ khyung chen nyer gcig gi go cha/ rgyun khyer srung 'khor sogs mang du gsungs kyang 'dir ma spros/

gzungs las 'byung ba'i rmi lam mthong ba'i gzungs ni/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ mu tsi ni swā hā/ mu khe se swā hā/ mo ha ni swā hā/ dan+ti ri swā hā/ cho ga ni chu khyor ba gang bzlas pa byas te/ 'thungs nas sems bzhin du nyal na lag na rdo rjes rmi lam ston par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud las klu sman/ dbang lag chu srin sder mo/ nā ga ge sar/ nā ga puṣ+pa/ spos dkar/ 'bras yos/ rdo rgyus bya bal ma/

thang ka bya rgyus spu shel zhes gda'/ ga bur/ dar le brgan/ mtshal/ dung*/ ras skud dmar po/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum bcas rin po che'i bum pa'am kham phor lta bu mchu lnga par blugs nas sbas na klu'i nyams pa thams cad sos par gsungs pa'ang 'dir zhar byung du smos pa'o// 'di'i dam tshig ni/ rdo rje dril bu la mi 'gong zhing rtag tu bcang*/ me tog sngon po la mi 'gong*/ khyung gi dam tshig tu bya sha dang sgo nga mi za/ mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ ma grub bar du rta dang mi sha mi za/ klu gtor rgyun du gtang bar bya'o// phyag rdor gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud dang*/ gtum po nā ga klu 'dul nag po'i rgyud/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa sel ba'i gzungs las kyang 'di'i rtsa sngags tsaṇ+ḍa ma gsungs nas/ gshis ngan du 'chi ba bcu gsum ste/ dug mtshon/ lhog pa/ gcan gzan gyis za ba/ mes tshig pa/ chur 'chi ba/ 'go ba'i rims/ mdze nad/ gzhan yang gsor mi rung ba'i nad ya nga ba/ g.yang la lhung ba/ gzhan gyi byad dang*/ zas kyis brnang ba dang*/ bdag rang gis gsod pa ste gshis ngan du 'chi ba bcu gsum gyis rkyen byed par mi 'gyur ro// 'di 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ bzlas brjod byed pa la ni sa dang nam mkha' la gnas pa'i bgegs dregs pa can ma rungs pa rnams kyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// de la las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag ste/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa 'byung ngo*// ras chung lugs kyi gtum po'i skor 'di rnams slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes gnam lcags 'bar ba srog gzer gyi rgyud/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyud/ glog phreng drag po 'khor lo'i rgyud gsum las byung bar bshad do// dge 'dis bla ma gsang ba'i bdag po yis// skye kun rjes bzung thugs kyi gsang ba thob// byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad kun zhi zhing*// mthu chen thob dang rnam thar gcig gyur shog

/'di'i sgrub rjes rtsa ba rje bla ma rin po che nyid kyis mdzad nas 'phros lus su gyur pa'i dgongs pa skong ba'i ched du phyag tho'i sa bcad rtsa bar bzung ste bsnyen yig phyin gyi mjug mthud du 'du gsum pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos tswa 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
